decisive_items: curettage yielded a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue
There was no tenderness on percussion of the involved teeth
sent for histopathological examination with a provisional diagnosis of periapical granuloma
response.rationale: The gelatinous, soft tissue and absence of percussion tenderness favor periapical granuloma over abscess; the provisional abscess diagnosis was superseded by histopathologic evaluation.

rejected.why: Abscess is contradicted by lack of percussion tenderness and the gelatinous curettage findings, which are more typical of granuloma.
